meta.name: muapi-rednote-cover
meta.description: Create a Xiaohongshu (RedNote/小红书) style cover image — vibrant, lifestyle-focused, with aesthetic typography overlay suitable for the Chinese social platform.

copy.tagline: 生成小红书风格封面图，带生活美学文字排版
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为小红书笔记制作吸引眼球的封面图
copy.tagline_en: Create Xiaohongshu-style cover images with aesthetic typography
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need eye-catching cover images for Xiaohongshu notes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的主题、风格和文字，生成一张小红书风格的封面图。图片会带有柔和光线、生活感构图和美观的文字排版，适合发在小红书平台。
howto.when: 当你提到“小红书”、“rednote”、“xhs cover”等关键词，或要求制作小红书封面图时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一张“早间护肤流程”的小红书封面，暖色调。
say.note: 生成一张暖色调的护肤主题封面。

say.text: 生成一张“秋季穿搭”封面，文字写“今日穿搭✨”，竖版。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a Xiaohongshu-style cover image based on your topic, style, and optional text overlay. The image features soft lighting, lifestyle composition, and aesthetic typography, suitable for the Chinese social platform.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "rednote", "xiaohongshu", "xhs cover", or ask to create a Xiaohongshu cover image.

say_en.text: Create a Xiaohongshu cover for "morning skincare routine" in warm tones.
Generate an "autumn outfit" cover with text "今日穿搭✨" in portrait orientation.
say_en.note: Generates a portrait cover with text.
